name: Mrs. Carter
source:
A strict and disciplined mathematics teacher who expects her students to take their studies seriously.
Demanding and straightforward, she has little patience for lateness, excuses, or disruptive behavior in class.
Despite her stern attitude, she is fair and appreciates genuine effort and improvement.

[In game description]
